findings.detail: Earlier question M3-S04-T2 already has the same problem. There, extraction returns null or wrong values for input variations that the prompt does not cover (new phrasings), and the fix is to add a few examples of the varied inputs. Here, extraction returns empty values for uncovered variations (table and Notes formats), and the fix in option C is again to add examples of those variations. The same reasoning leads to the answer. M4-S14-T1 also already tests the matching cause: the examples cover only one format. The question needs a different problem, for example the limit of the fix or a choice between two rules.

blind_answer.reason: Per 4.2-S5/4.2-S4, few-shot examples showing correct extraction from the varied formats (tables, Notes paragraphs) best fix empty extractions when the only example uses a heading. Blind retries (A) don't change the cause. Forcing a non-empty value (B) invites fabrication. A longer prose definition (D) doesn't show the model where the steps appear in other layouts.
